what: A small pill (11.75×2.5rem) hidden at the bottom center of the screen rises over .5s cubic-bezier(.46,.03,.12,1) when you scroll up more than 16px after passing a set section (hero), and sinks again when you scroll down more than 16px. Click it and the pill opens over .8s expo.out into a panel min(23.25rem, screen−2rem) wide and as tall as the list. The text slides off to the right, the two-line icon moves to the panel center and rotates ±45° into an X, and the list rows slide in from −(6+10·index)rem over .7s. Closing rewinds the same path 1.35× faster. It closes on outside click, Esc, scrolling down, or when smooth scroll stops

options.[data-fx-part=list]: List inside panel (stacks up above the pill)
options.[data-fx-part=row]: List row — each item slides in from far away in turn
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Button text — when open, slides out to the right
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Two-line icon (two spans inside) — when open, the lines move to the center and form an X
options.after: Appears only after passing this Section (selector, optional) — from the start if absent
options.threshold: Roll amount when changing direction (px), default 16

note: While hidden, the element gets inert and moves below the bottom edge (css selects it with [inert]). It hides when smooth scroll stops (html.lenis-stopped — menu·page transition). Panel background·text are --kf-surface·--kf-accent.
